name: Revuele Body Lotion SPF 50+
description:
Ultimate hydration and high protection for glowing healthy skin. Revuele Sunprotect Daily Face Cream – Moisture Boost, SPF 50+ ensures daily sun protection against UVA and UVB rays. Its weightless formula hydrates your skin and gives you a revitalising sensation. It doesn’t leave a sticky residue on your skin, and leaves your skin fresh, smooth, and young-looking.

Characteristics:

provides SPF50+ protection against UVA and UVB damage

hydrates the skin

gives a refreshing feeling

Ingredients:

lightweight formula that doesn’t leave a sticky residue

How to apply:

Apply Revuele Sunprotect Daily Face Cream – Moisture Boost, SPF 50+ before sun exposure. Reapply regularly.
